chunks: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from Abū Baṣīr, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, "I went to perform the stoning, and then there were six pebbles in my hand." So he said, "Take one from beneath your feet."

key_terms.أَرْمِي: to perform the throwing of pebbles in the hajj rite
key_terms.حَصَيَاتٍ: small pebbles used for the stoning ritual
key_terms.سِتُّ: the number six, indicating one pebble short of the required count
key_terms.وَاحِدَةً: one pebble to complete the required number

ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do if he has only six pebbles during the stoning ritual in hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a practical ruling related to the rite of ramy during hajj. It shows that if a pilgrim finds the pebbles one short while throwing, he may complete the number by taking one from beneath his feet.
